description: Baseline acoustic deepfake classifier using log-Mel spectrogram representations. Currently untrained / experimental skeleton.
known_limitations: Untrained baseline skeleton. Model weights are not trained on speech deepfake datasets.
Detection probabilities are heuristic placeholders and must NOT be used for security-critical decisions.
Requires training on speaker-disjoint balanced datasets (e.g., ASVspoof, WaveFake, In-The-Wild).
